title: blubbr
tagline: A powerful social portal for creators and investors to web3 with subscription models, token gating, analytics, dashboards, cutting edge UI/UX, NFT, DEFI, as well as gamified experiences to suit creators and consumers alike.
description: This project allows you to connect your wallet to our dapp and use it as a portal into web3. Open browser, connect wallet, and see all of the information needed to get a good overview of the space, your balances, socials, and tools to allow NFT and token tracking, acquisition, heat maps, and AI/ML to help trade - all through a flawless user experience thanks to our cutting edge design, user interface, and collaborations/partnerships. A place where the attention economy and the web3 economy meet.
how_its_made:
-Blockchains blubbr is focused on mainnet for the MVP, but will include Polygon, Aave and possibly others depending on our progress.
-Wagmi auth
-Storage IPFS and Filecoin are used for image storage when needed. IPFS  is used to host files when pushing content through the social side.
-Social Lens will be used to allow users to follow each other's activity, post and interact and mirror.xyz is used to enable content creation.
-Data Querying QuickNode's NFT API is used for gathering data about the currently signed in user's NFTs they've collected. It may also be used for DeFi information if we get that far. The Graph is used to query data about ERC20 tokens held by the signed in user.
-Notifications Notifications are sent via EPNS for activity that occurs on blubbr.
-Unlock could be used for NFT licensing to enable access to a paid tier of blubbr.
-Quicknode APIs to pull data for NFTs and Tokens
